cases.title: ISRO Satellite Communications Enhancement
cases.challenge: ISRO needed high-performance RF amplifiers with 100 MHz–40 GHz capability for satellite communication uplinks with proven linearity and reliability for extended mission durations.
cases.solution: Telogica designed custom RF power amplifier modules integrated into ISRO's satellite communication ground stations. The component-to-subsystem approach ensured single-source accountability and seamless integration.
results: Enhanced uplink performance with 95%+ system efficiency
Reduced supplier qualification time from 18 months to 4 months
Improved satellite communication reliability by 40%
Long-term partnership for next-generation satellite systems
cases.testimonial: Telogica's commitment to performance and reliability has been invaluable for our space missions.

cases.title: HAL Fighter Radar System Integration
cases.challenge: HAL's fighter radar platform required defense-grade RF components with stringent MIL-SPEC testing, wide bandwidth, and high linearity for hostile electronic warfare environments.
cases.solution: Telogica supplied fully tested and certified RF amplifiers and subsystems meeting defense specifications. Our test-and-measurement foundation enabled rapid integration and validation.
results: Full compliance with defense specifications and testing protocols
50% reduction in system integration time
Zero field failures in first 3 years of deployment
Approved as primary RF component supplier for next-gen radar
cases.testimonial: Telogica's defense-grade components are the backbone of our fighter radar systems.

cases.title: Bharti Airtel FTTH Network Deployment
cases.challenge: Bharti Airtel needed rapid fiber-to-the-home (FTTH) deployment across urban centers with reliable splicing equipment and network testing tools for installation and maintenance crews.
cases.solution: Telogica provided fusion splicers, cable fault locators, and site analyzers as an integrated deployment toolkit. Field training and support ensured crews could achieve high-speed deployment.
results: Deployed 500,000+ fiber connections in 18 months
Reduced splicing time from 5 minutes to 2 minutes per joint
Network maintenance cost reduction of 35%
Customer satisfaction score: 4.8/5 for installation quality
cases.testimonial: Telogica's equipment and support were critical to our FTTH expansion.

cases.title: BSNL Network Maintenance Infrastructure
cases.challenge: BSNL required portable, rugged test equipment for telecom infrastructure maintenance across India's remote and harsh environments, with minimal training overhead.
cases.solution: Telogica supplied ruggedized network analyzers, OTDR systems, and cable locators optimized for field deployment. Equipment design prioritized portability and ease of use.
results: Deployed across 100+ BSNL maintenance centers
Reduced network troubleshooting time by 50%
Improved field technician productivity by 40%
Extended equipment lifespan through rugged design
cases.testimonial: Telogica's test equipment has become indispensable for our network operations.

cases.title: Indian Railways Communication System Upgrade
cases.challenge: Indian Railways needed reliable RF communication systems for train operations and signaling that could withstand harsh environments and electromagnetic interference from railway infrastructure.
cases.solution: Telogica designed RF systems with high environmental immunity, built-in redundancy, and seamless integration with legacy railway communication infrastructure.
results: Train-to-dispatch communication reliability improved to 99.8%
Signaling system performance enhanced with lower latency
Operating costs reduced through efficient power consumption
Zero downtime in first 18 months of deployment
cases.testimonial: Telogica's systems ensure safe and reliable railway operations nationwide.
